need.question: 在人类 ICI 治疗队列中，是否有干预性研究证实特定饮食模式（如高纤维）通过改变微生物组直接改善了 ICI 疗效？

high fiber diet randomized trial immunotherapy efficacy

success_criteria: 找到 1 项人类饮食干预试验报告微生物组变化与 ICI 疗效的因果链条，或确认现有证据仅为观察性关联。
need.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?

still_missing: The success criterion requires reporting microbiome changes alongside ICI efficacy to establish a causal chain (diet -> microbiome -> efficacy). While this study is the specific interventional trial design needed, the supplied text does not report the primary outcome data regarding microbiome structure or function changes, nor does it present mediation analysis linking microbiome shifts to the observed clinical benefits (EFS, ORR). Therefore, based solely on this text, the mechanistic link 'via microbiome changes' remains unconfirmed, even though the interventional efficacy signal is present.
usable_content: This study conducted a proof-of-principle randomized controlled trial with fully controlled feeding in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). It compared a High Fiber Diet Intervention (HFDI, ramped to 50 g/d) against a healthy control diet (20 g/d). The authors reported exploratory cancer-specific outcomes showing that in the combined neoadjuvant/unresectable cohort (n=24), the HFDI arm had a median event-free survival (EFS) not reached versus 20 months in control (p=0.03), and an objective response rate (ORR) of 77% versus 29% (p=0.06). In the adjuvant cohort, recurrence rate was 14% (HFDI) versus 33% (control). Any grade immune-related adverse events (IRAEs) were lower in the HFDI arm (71.4% vs 93.3%). The study design explicitly states the primary objective was to establish effects on gut microbiome structure and function, confirming the trial was designed to test the diet-microbiome-efficacy axis. 这项研究（DIET 试验，NCT04645680）是一项在黑色素瘤患者中进行的二期随机双盲饮食干预试验，比较了高纤维饮食（30-50 克/天）与健康对照饮食（20 克/天）对免疫检查点阻断（ICB）疗效的影响。摘要报告了早期结果显示高纤维饮食干预可行且治疗结果有改善前景。研究通过外周血单核细胞（PBMC）分析发现，高纤维组在第 5-8 周循环单核细胞、树突状细胞减少，效应记忆 T 细胞增加，且 T 细胞激活信号通路增强。此外，研究进行了人至小鼠的粪便微生物移植（FMT）实验，接受高纤维饮食后患者粪便的小鼠表现出更好的 ICB 反应和类似的免疫细胞变化，提示这种益处具有微生物组依赖性。 This study describes a proposed prospective dietary intervention clinical trial design targeting melanoma patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI). The authors plan to implement a sequential intervention involving a high-fermented food diet followed by high-fiber supplementation. The study aims to longitudinally assess gut microbial signatures and evaluate distinct immunological, proteomic, and metabolomic effects associated with these dietary modifications. This study conducted a randomized, cross-over dietary intervention trial (BEWELL Study) in humans, administering black raspberry (BRB) nectar versus a matched placebo. The authors reported that the BRB intervention significantly increased the abundance of Lachnospiraceae in the human gut microbiome, with less physically active participants showing a greater increase. To assess the functional impact on immunotherapy, stool samples from participants (pre- and post-intervention) were transferred into tumor-bearing mouse models (mc38, CMT167) which were then treated with anti-PD1. The mice receiving post-BRB human stool exhibited smaller tumor volumes compared to those receiving pre-BRB stool. Additionally, culturing and supplementing a specific Lachnospiraceae isolate into pre-BRB stool recapitulated the improved response to ICB in the mouse model. This establishes a mechanistic chain where a specific human dietary intervention alters the microbiome, and that altered microbiome confers improved ICI efficacy in a preclinical model. ['该综述综合了 49 项研究（机制、临床前、观察性和干预性），明确指出人类 ICI 治疗队列中关于饮食纤维干预的证据主要为观察性关联（如 Spencer 等报告的高纤维摄入与 PFS 改善相关，n=128，自报告数据），而非已完成的干预性因果链条验证。', '文中列举了正在进行的干预性临床试验（如 NCT04107168, NCT03643289 等），旨在评估饮食操纵或益生元补充对微生物组和 ICI 疗效的影响，但表明这些数据尚未发布或不足以确立因果关系。', '提及一项早期病例报告（2 例转移性黑色素瘤患者，nivolumab 联合卡姆卡姆益生元后获得缓解），但明确指出其样本量有限，仅作为正在进行试验的理由，不能确立队列层面的因果链条。', '总结了微生物组介导的潜在机制（纤维发酵产生 SCFA、GPCR 信号、HDAC 抑制、DC 激活、CD8+ T 细胞 priming），为解释观察性关联提供了生物学合理性，但注明这些机制多源于临床前模型或非黑色素瘤癌症。']
